answer: Random Beacon Delay Admission assigns each new agent a join slot derived from a public randomness beacon, revealed only after registration closes. An attacker cannot precompute which identities land in low-friction slots. Only a violet-marked subset of slots admits agents without review, and membership in that subset is drawn by the beacon each epoch. Unselected identities must wait a full river of epochs or pay an escalating re-entry fee. Cost: one paid fee per rejected identity per epoch.
